name: artifacts-dependency-triage-eval
description: Fixture repo for evaluating GitHub dependency update triage

scripts.test:smoke: node -e "const axios=require('axios'); const chunk=require('lodash/chunk'); const React=require('react'); if (typeof axios.get !== 'function') throw new Error('axios failed to load'); if (chunk([1,2,3,4],2).length !== 2) throw new Error('lodash failed to load'); if (typeof React.createElement !== 'function') throw new Error('react failed to load'); console.log('Dependency smoke test passed');"
scripts.test:react-compat: node -e "const major=Number(require('react/package.json').version.split('.')[0]); if (major >= 19) { console.error('React 19 requires manual review in this evaluation repo'); process.exit(1); } console.log('React compatibility check passed');"
scripts.test: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:tooling && npm run test:react-compat
